execution_authorization.reason: SOURCE_READY only; root review required before any numerical path is added or invoked

geometry.shape: straight-front finite crack sheet extruded through centered cylinder
geometry.frame: global xyz; front is z axis through origin

source_binding.flattening_order: itertools.product(x_axis,y_axis,z_axis), z fastest; IDs node-000 through node-026
source_binding.accepted_cache_identity_gate: Before any numerical provider call, future loader must compare the cached source_ids and source_positions_xyz_m arrays exactly to these explicit ordered values; SOURCE_READY only binds the accepted array SHA/audit metadata without opening the NPZ.
source_binding.match_required: exactly equal to 27 coordinates in accepted cached 93 result and product grid in frozen full3d fixed_case.json

registry.trace_family_semantics: Enrichment-family label only; 93 registry intentionally contains SOURCE_BASE plus GLOBAL_FRONT. Preserve exact semantic tokens and order.
registry.base_order: source IDs sorted; each source ux,uy,uz as [SOURCE_BASE,source_id,component,0]
registry.global_order: branch-major F1..F4; each branch ux,uy,uz as [GLOBAL_FRONT,global,component,branch_index]

mls.query_contract: Run continuous 27-source MLS directly for 16 common physical points. Use its BASE shape values for both face operators; do not adapt the existing 162-DOF FRONT_F1 provider as the 93 registry.
per_query_gates: status exactly MLSStatus.OK; any UNKNOWN/non-finite value fails closed
condition_number <= frozen max_condition_number; no threshold relaxation
partition of unity and linear first moment reproduce the physical query
sum gradients is zero and source-coordinate gradient moment is identity
record support count and condition number; require all 27 sites in support
mls.affine_reproduction_tolerance: 1e-10 in normalized coordinates, separate value and derivative identities

interface_quadrature.rule: tensor Gauss-Legendre order 4 in x times order 4 in z

branch_trace_contract.jump_contract: One MLS BASE row at identical xyz for H+ and H-. H+ and H- differ only in the 12 GLOBAL_FRONT entries for F1 vector components. J=H+-H- has the three F1 diagonal entries 2*sqrt(-x/R).
branch_trace_contract.normal_projection_contract: J^T*n has only zero-based coefficient index 82 (F1,uy), value 2*sqrt(-x/R).

load_and_cache_binding.recovery_rule: Read actual pure_I q_solution and retain pure_I q_exact separately as diagnostic only. Future numerical path must verify accepted arrays SHA before opening NPZ; SOURCE_READY check does not open/hash/read NPZ.
load_and_cache_binding.scaled_solution_preflight: Verify physical weak residual, six physical gauge equations and 99-order KKT backward error after scaling before using q0.

cohesive_law.material_classification: toy elastic-scale bridge only; not a real material or ceramic calibration
cohesive_law.initial_history: virgin immutable CohesiveState for each of 16 unique QP IDs
cohesive_law.physical_trial_gate: Every baseline and coupled-final QP has 0<opening<delta0, no damage, kappa<delta0, zero tangential jump within existing primitive tolerance; compression/shear/mixed slip is UNKNOWN and aborts without projection.

calls.name: baseline
calls.purpose: verify actual opening, normal-only mode, baseline traction and elastic tangent

calls.name: zero_tangent_control
calls.history: synthetic fully-damaged committed states with kappa=deltaf
calls.purpose: verify zero traction/zero algorithmic tangent; diagnostic only, state discarded, excluded from physics and solve

calls.name: coupled_final
calls.trial: q_c from the one coupled KKT solve
calls.purpose: independently verify final elastic force, tangent, opening and energy ledger

rigid_modes.vectors_from: pinned mixed enriched operator rigid_body_mode_coefficients, exact semantic ID match required
rigid_modes.coefficient_construction: Translations are BASE nodal unit displacements; rotations are omega cross (X_source-center) in metres for unit radians; all GLOBAL_FRONT coefficients zero.
rigid_modes.point_displacement: translation unit vector or omega cross (x_q-center)
gates: each H+ and H- reproduces expected rigid point displacement at every QP
J*q_rigid is zero for all six modes at every QP
actual cached rigid vectors and rebuilt vectors have exact 93 semantic order and rank six

interface_mechanics.internal_force_sign: f_Gamma = dU_Gamma/dq = +sum(A*J^T*n*t); add +KG to bulk K on left
interface_mechanics.physical_face_traction_sign: upper actual face traction is -t*n and lower is +t*n for positive opening
interface_mechanics.primitive_positive_face_force_semantics: +A*t*n is an internal-potential bookkeeping share, not physical applied force on upper face
interface_mechanics.required_sign_identity: q dot f_Gamma = sum(A*opening*traction) = 2*U_Gamma > 0 on virgin elastic opening

coupled_problem.allowed_matrix_changes: add only analytic and primitive-verified positive elastic KG
coupled_problem.baseline_comparison: q0 is scaled actual recovered q_solution; require q_c-q0 and KG*q_c exceed the fixed norm-scaled roundoff floors

acceptance_gates.mls: 16/16 OK, support count 27, unchanged condition limit and affine reproduction
acceptance_gates.exact_trace: 16 common points, F1 +/- pi limits exact; BASE identical; only F1 branch jumps
acceptance_gates.rigid: six actual rigid coefficient vectors reproduced on both traces and annihilated by J
acceptance_gates.qp_mode: all baseline and coupled-final openings positive and below delta0, tangential jump zero by existing tolerance
acceptance_gates.stiffness: KG only [82,82]=20000 N/m to 1e-12 relative; full K and K+KG each 6 zero/87 positive and no negatives under unchanged 64*eps*93*max(abs(eigs)) threshold
acceptance_gates.equilibrium: physical weak residual, six gauge equations and KKT backward error <=1e-9
acceptance_gates.energy: 2*(Ubulk+UGamma)-q_c.dot(f_ext_scaled)+g_scaled.dot(lambda)=0 within 1e-9 relative scale; Ubulk=0.5*q_c^T K q_c; UGamma=0.5*q_c^T KG q_c and matches primitive stored energy; virgin elastic dissipated energy=0
acceptance_gates.mechanical_change: KG nonzero; actual cohesive force and q_c-q0 nonzero beyond predeclared numerical floor
acceptance_gates.primitive: baseline and final generalized force/tangent equal KG*q and KG; zero-tangent synthetic control returns zero force/tangent and is discarded

nonclaims: no real material or ceramic calibration
no physical crack extension or autonomous front update
no process-zone resolution or mixed-mode fracture qualification
a finite cohesive tangent and changed equilibrium do not establish crack growth
